reviews.text:
I really loved this serum. After about two days, I already noticed that my skin looked more fresh, healthy, and glowy. I have tried other products before, but with this one I felt like I saw a visible difference pretty quickly, which honestly surprised me in the best way.

Just a small note: at first, it does feel a little prickly/tingly because of the “spicule” effect, so it’s good to be prepared for that and not panic. For me, the sensation calmed down after a short while and didn’t feel too intense.

Overall, I think it’s an amazing product, especially if you’re looking for a more radiant, smooth, and healthy-looking complexion. I genuinely recommend it, just make sure to use it correctly and gradually.
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意呢款精華。大約兩日之後，我已經見到皮膚睇落更加清新、健康同有光澤。我之前試過其他產品，但係用呢款嘅時候，好快就見到明顯嘅改善，老實講真係令我好正面咁感到驚喜。

要提一提：一開始，因為「spicule」效果，佢會有少少刺痛／麻麻地嘅感覺，所以最好有心理準備，唔好驚。對我嚟講，呢種感覺過咗一陣就平伏咗，而且唔算太強烈。

整體嚟講，我覺得係一款非常好嘅產品，尤其係如果你想要更加有光澤、順滑同健康睇落嘅膚色。我真心推薦，只要你正確咁用、循序漸進就得。

reviews.text: I received this item about a week ago and already love it. It definitely helps my other products absorb deeper and more quickly. My skin feels very moisturized and it has helped my fine lines on my forehead. I will be purchasing it again. The “stinging” people report is to me more like a very mild prickle. It is there but it does not bother me and it does not actually irritate my skin at all.
reviews.zh: 我大約一個星期前收到呢件產品，已經好鍾意。佢確實幫我其他產品滲入得更深、更快。我皮膚感覺好滋潤，而且幫咗我額頭嘅細紋。我會再買。大家話嘅「刺痛」感，對我嚟講比較似好輕微嘅刺麻。確實有，但係唔會令我困擾，而且其實完全唔會刺激我嘅皮膚。

reviews.text: I really like this serum. It stings a little at first, but those are just the little reedle needles that are penetrating the skin. I use it in combination with other serums and I think it makes the absorption of those better as well.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款精華。起初會有少少刺痛，但呢啲只係小小嘅 reedle 針喺滲入皮膚嘅感覺。我同其他精華一齊用，我覺得亦都令嗰啲精華更容易吸收。

reviews.text: I saw this online and thought I'd try it as I was beginning to notice some fine lines on my skin as well as dry skin. The effects are great and I love the glow it gives leaving my skin feeling and looking amazing. At first I applied a small amount due to the stinging feeling but after using almost daily I now use more with less stinging. Overall really happy with the results and will be purchasing again.
reviews.zh: 我喺網上見到呢款，就諗住試吓，因為我開始留意到皮膚有啲細紋，同埋皮膚乾燥。效果好好，我好鍾意佢帶出嚟嘅光澤，令我皮膚感覺同睇落都好靚。起初因為有刺痛感，我只係搽少量，但係差不多每日都用之後，而家我用多咗，刺痛感亦都減少咗。整體嚟講都好滿意效果，會再買。

reviews.text: I have recently started using this and my skin love it .This serum absorbs easily and gives the natural glow .I use it in combination with PDRN cream one day ,and second day I combine it with numbuzin9+ .I love the result
reviews.zh: 我最近開始用呢款，我嘅皮膚好鍾意。呢款精華好易吸收，帶出自然嘅光澤。我一日同 PDRN 面霜一齊用，第二日就同 numbuzin9+ 一齊用。我好鍾意效果。

reviews.text: After loving the original Reedle Shot, I decided to test out this. Although I can't really say yet what is so unique about this Collagen reedle shot, as compared to the original, it does work well at enhancing my other skincare. I use it every night after cleansing, but before moisturizer. I will say though, that I noticed the fine lines on my forehead got smoother way faster after I started using this at night (before that, I had been using the original one both morning and night, for maybe a month or two)
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意原版 Reedle Shot，所以決定試吓呢款。雖然我而家未可以話清楚呢款 Collagen reedle shot 同原版比有咩咁獨特之處，但係佢確實幫我加強其他護膚產品嘅效果。我每晚潔面後、搽保濕霜之前都會用。我要講，自從我晚上開始用呢款之後，我額頭嘅細紋明顯更快變得順滑（之前，我早晚都用原版，大約用咗一兩個月）。
